source.text: 有獸，左右有首，名曰屏蓬。

inferred.item: 四足猫科兽形与一条中短尾
inferred.basis: 原文只称兽，未指定物种、足数、尾数或尾长；猫科躯干、四足足掌、耳鼻形态和单尾均为设计补足，不将猪形并入 source。

inferred.item: 同一宽肩向左右分出短颈，各接一首
inferred.basis: 据「左右有首」明确画出横向并列的两首；具体双颈、同一肩带的连接结构、头颈大小及位置均为构型解释，不作前后双首。
经文未记两首的具体朝向、视线或转动范围；左右对称向外张望的角度是为了辨认左右双首而作的设计选择。

inferred.item: 赭褐斑毛、米白颌胸与琥珀双眸
inferred.basis: 本条没有猪形、黑色或其他色彩记录；全部毛色、斑纹、鼻爪色及两首相同的琥珀眼色均为艺术设色。

inferred.item: 四足稳步、双首侧望与交替低吟
inferred.basis: 正文未记习性、动作或鸣声；四拍缓步、微呼吸、双首侧望、尾部回摆及合成低吟均为交互演绎，不补写争执不能前进等后世说法。

sourceVerification.contextBefore: 大荒之中，有山，名曰鏖鏊鉅，日月所入者。
sourceVerification.contextAfter: 有巫山者。有壑山者。有金門之山，有人名曰黄姖之尸。
sourceVerification.note: 本条独立为有獸，左右有首，名曰屏蓬。相邻山名并未明确写屏蓬居于该山，故不拼接引文或推演栖地；没有猪形、黑色、前后双首，也不与并封混为一兽。

bodyAndHeads.note: Returned filename is base_basic_pbr.glb; Extreme-High identity independently checked in credits.log plus hashes and mesh counts. Both lateral heads are duplicated crops from this verified master, not separately generated HIGH jobs.

production.adaptation: Offline anatomical repair from the two existing verified HIGH masters, with zero new generation or TTS requests. The original central head is removed; two lateral native head surfaces retain 7,205 polygons each before seam fairing. Two copies of real feline upper shoulder/throat tissue are smoothly deformed apart above a common scapular root, voxel-unioned at 2 mm and cut open. Six actual boundary loops are bridged to the retained lower body and head surfaces, subdivided and faired across the seams; imported custom normals are cleared and valid topology receives coherent smooth normals. This reconstructs the upper shoulder/body above z=.60 rather than preserving all HIGH triangles or hiding capped primitives. Original retained UV islands remain; a 1024-square atlas bakes the new tissue from deformed donor UVs using BVH barycentric sampling. Unintended pale pink sternum texels are neutralized. The lowest 4 mm plantar band is compressed with a smooth 4–8 mm transition and a positive Jacobian; inverse-transpose normal guards remain. The existing single tail is curved offline. A 39-bone rig has independent three-bone left/right neck chains plus head bones and thirteen tail bones, with continuous weights across the welded joins. Runtime owns a SkeletonUtils clone, fresh effect-created mixer actions after uncacheRoot, ink/outline resources and deduplicated skeleton disposal. A Screen Peng-only analytic stance solver preserves soles, fades the release correction during swing, and accelerates the root over the first walk cycle; no shared contact helper is changed.
